name: Business
description: An organization engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities

name: Legal Structure
description: The legal form under which a business operates

name: Revenue Model
description: The strategy and methods by which a business generates income

name: Business Location
description: Physical or virtual place where business operations occur

name: Business Department
description: Specialized division within an organization

name: Business Process
description: Set of coordinated activities to achieve business objectives

name: Business Task
description: Individual unit of work within a process
examples: Review Invoice, Contact Customer, Update Database

name: Business Resource
description: Asset available for use in operations

name: Business Metric
description: Quantifiable measure used to track performance
examples: Revenue Growth, Customer Acquisition Cost, Employee Turnover

name: Business Goal
description: Desired outcome or objective
examples: Revenue Target, Market Share, Customer Satisfaction

name: Stakeholder Relationship
description: Connection between business and interested parties
examples: Investor Relations, Customer Relations, Supplier Relations

name: Compliance Requirement
description: Legal or regulatory obligation
examples: Tax Filing, Labor Law, Data Privacy, Industry Regulation

name: Business Risk
description: Potential threat to business operations or objectives
examples: Market Risk, Operational Risk, Financial Risk

name: Risk Mitigation Strategy
description: Approach to reduce or manage risk

name: Business Capability
description: Organizational ability to execute activities
examples: Digital Marketing, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Management

name: Local Business
description: Business serving a specific geographic community

name: Retail
description: Sells goods directly to consumers from physical location

name: Restaurant
description: Prepares and serves food and beverages

name: Professional Services
description: Provides expertise-based services locally

name: Healthcare
description: Provides medical services to local community

name: Real Estate
description: Facilitates property transactions and management

name: Personal Services
description: Provides personal care and improvement services

name: Home Services
description: Provides residential maintenance and improvement

name: Automotive
description: Sells and services vehicles

name: Hospitality
description: Provides lodging and accommodation services

name: Local Manufacturing
description: Produces goods in local facility

name: Education Services
description: Provides educational instruction locally

name: Online Business
description: Business operating primarily through digital channels

name: Ecommerce
description: Sells physical or digital goods online

name: Content Platform
description: Provides content for consumption or engagement

name: Digital Marketplace
description: Connects buyers and sellers in online environment

name: Software As Service
description: Delivers software applications via subscription model

name: Online Education
description: Provides educational content and instruction digitally

name: Digital Agency
description: Provides digital marketing and creative services

name: Online Financial
description: Provides financial services digitally

name: Subscription Box
description: Delivers curated physical products regularly

name: Online Consulting
description: Provides expert advice and services remotely

name: Online Community
description: Builds and monetizes digital communities

name: Digital Tools
description: Provides online utilities and productivity tools
